headline: Arsox mount
title: Arsox | Fire Mount With Cold Resistance | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need an early fire mount? Arsox can be ridden in Palworld one point zero. Its partner skill, Warm Body, gives you plus two cold resistance while it is in your party, which helps in snowy areas. At your base it works Kindling level three and Lumbering level two. Will you ride Arsox? Comment below!
description: Arsox in Palworld 1.0 is a rideable Fire Pal that gives cold resistance and works at kindling level three.
